text: A familiar voice is no longer proof.
This sounds like Sam. Sam never said it.
From a short clip of Sam talking, software learns how Sam's voice sounds.
Then it says brand-new words in that voice, and a familiar voice feels believable.
But it copies the sound, not what Sam knows, like your family code word.
So when a call urgently asks for money, hang up and call back on a number you already know.
